other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident/domicile of Odisha for at least 20 years
Must not have been convicted of any criminal offence involving moral turpitude
Must not be receiving any other pension from the union or state government or any organization aided by the government
Must be a widow (for certain benefits)
Must be a leprosy patient with visible signs of deformity
Must be a person aged 5 years or above who is unable to do normal work due to benchmark disability (blind, orthopedically handicapped, mentally retarded, cerebral palsy)
Must be the widow of an AIDS patient
Must be an AIDS patient identified by the State/District AIDS Control Society (irrespective of income)
Must be an unmarried woman belonging to BPL category
benefits_summary: Pension of ₹500 per month for beneficiaries aged 60‑79, and ₹700 per month for those aged 80 and above.
